_comment: LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions. Its docs list WebP, but its endpoint rejects data:image/webp on current builds (lmstudio-bug-tracker #1752 on 0.4.9, #1839 on 0.4.12, read 2026-10-19), so vBot converts WebP and GIF to a declared type instead of sending a failing request.
